column3: “The people of” replaces according to the flesh.
“Pagans” matches the Textus Receptus “the Gentiles” (ἔθνη); the critical text has no expressed subject.
“Others” is plural where the Greek has the other.
“Questions of conscience” recasts examining on account of conscience.
“To a meal” is supplied; “questions of conscience” recasts examining on account of conscience.
“To idols” makes the recipient of the sacrifice explicit.
